name: Two tablets, one promise

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: Within the sandstone halls of Zul'Farrak, the search turns to two Mosh'aru tablets held by guardians of the ruins. The prophecy describes a means to contain an essence. The recovered fragments are evidence for a plan, not a guarantee that the plan is safe, or that Yeh'kinya has disclosed every purpose for which he seeks them.
